skills.frame-analogize: Build and stress-test an analogy for a settled concept. Use for ELI5, metaphors, or 'explain differently'; compares candidates and names where the winner breaks.
skills.frame-draw: Decide how to picture something already understood: which form the question asks for, and which medium carries it (terminal, markdown, mermaid, interactive). Owns the strategy, not one format.
skills.frame-first-principles: Rebuild a question or decision from irreducible axioms, separating necessity from convention. Use to challenge assumptions or reason from first principles.
skills.frame-orthogonal: Factor a tangled problem into independent axes and verify that moving one leaves the others fixed. Use to expose conflated or falsely coupled dimensions.
skills.frame-tinker: Build a small interactive object to poke: one control, a visible before/after, details revealed on request. Rendering candidates to decide belongs to seek-mockup; choosing a picture belongs to frame-draw.
skills.frame-unfold: Walk someone through a repository, paper, book, or concept one layer at a time, skeleton first, choosing a form per layer. Use for progressive-disclosure walkthroughs; a single explanation or ELI5 belongs to frame-analogize.
skills.nav-audit: Audit codebase architecture against deep-module principles. Use for health, smells, feature-readiness, or full-domain reviews; read-only.
skills.nav-do: Implement decided fixes/features or behavior-preserving refactors and verify them. Check or update README, docs, and source headers against code. Use for an engineering approach before edits when asked.
skills.nav-ship: Land verified work with release-doc checks, or clean up merged branches and worktrees. Use for ship it, commit/push/merge, or safe branch cleanup. Implementation belongs to nav-do.
skills.shape-tend: Connect a repository to its selected workspace, or tidy project records against code and decisions. Use for project setup and record cleanup; record additions belong to shape-add.
skills.shape-next: Choose and advance the next ready, already-authorized task or exploration. Use when asked to continue or work while the user is away; a status-only request belongs to shape-view.
skills.seek-elicit: Clarify an unsettled choice or specific cause through grounded conversation. Use for help me think this through; measurable claims belong to seek-probe and interactive comparisons to seek-mockup.
skills.seek-mockup: Build an interactive comparison when the user wants to see or try alternatives before choosing. Use for mockups and behavior comparisons; implementation and persistent records require their own scope.
skills.seek-probe: Test a measurable claim or assess existing measurements. Use for experiments and ablations; preferences belong to seek-mockup and built-feature usage to seek-dogfood.
skills.seek-dogfood: Use a built feature through its real interface to find reproducible friction and missing user paths. Use for try it or dogfood; testing an undecided claim belongs to seek-probe.
skills.shape-add: Capture an idea, define pending work, or update the original record with progress. Use for add this, save this or wrap this round; viewing progress belongs to shape-view and execution to nav-do.
skills.shape-view: Read current project work, priorities, blockers and next actions without changing records. Use for status or catch me up; continuing implementation belongs to shape-next.
